harvestIndicators: Pinch flowers to extend leaf production

careTasks.title: Pinch stems as they lengthen to promote bushy, compact growth.
Basil flower buds should be removed by pinching as soon as you see them form.
Limited harvesting of the leaves can start on young plants and as they get larger, individual leaves as well as tips of the plants can be harvested.

notes: Heat-loving annual. Downy mildew (BDM) is the big threat — DMR varieties (Prospera, Amazel) are alternatives.

preserving.note: Herbs in oil can grow Clostridium botulinum. Follow a tested method: keep oil infused with unacidified herbs in the refrigerator and discard it 4 days after making it, or acidify the herbs first exactly as UGA Extension Circular 1334 describes.

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch off basil flower buds
seasonalTasks.body: Pinch stem tips for a bushier plant, and pinch off flower buds as soon as you see them. Left on, buds change the flavor of the leaves.
